selection_timing: This seed list was selected only after the frozen model artifact was written and read back. No confirmation outcome was evaluated before this file was written.
search_contract: Exactly the frozen v2 development search contract. The verified natural+RCM incumbent is retained. At index65, frozen v1 continues unchanged unless it is in the exact v1-stop region best_gap65>11 with active challenger and no verified improvement certificate. frozen_v2_decision.ood: If any feature is outside the frozen closed development min/max box, abstain to frozen v1.
frozen_v2_decision.bootstrap_gate: At least 0.80 of at least 150 valid frozen 200 bootstrap refits must also produce probability >= 0.06881991110982628; otherwise abstain to frozen v1.
frozen_v2_decision.bootstrap_reproduction: Reconstruct development features and all 200 bootstrap models exactly and require model_bundle_sha256 99d2216065c70885aedb77b09a12b623d83eee7c1dd0a20fbc010f0741aa12a5 before any v2 decision.

audit: For evaluation only, exhaustively finish every v1-stop challenger tail regardless of v2 decision so missed gain is observable. Audit-only tail compute is not counted as deployed v2 compute. The retained incumbent means auditing cannot worsen the reported endpoint.

v2 recovered incremental gain and gain-weighted recall
selected deployed tail compilations / exhaustive audited stop-tail compilations
per-case no-harm relative to frozen v1

no_retuning: Model coefficients, scaler, threshold, OOD box, bootstrap rule, support gate and success rule are frozen for this confirmation. Outcomes may not be used to retune and then re-score this same split.
